_comment: Every section of the site: its URL key, where it sits on the scale bar, and its copy. Add an entry and its marker, homepage row, page at /key/ and CMS dropdown option all appear on the next build. Edit through CMS > Settings > Sections and Scale bar.

list.name: Cellular Automata
list.empty: Grids, rules, and the patterns they produce without being asked. Nothing here has a width in metres, which is why it sits off the end of the bar rather than anywhere on it.

list.name: Microscopy
list.blurb: Slides, objectives, and whatever turns up on them.
list.intro: Slides, objectives, and whatever turns up on them.
list.empty: Sample preparation, illumination, and the long argument between magnification and resolution. Anything that ends at an eyepiece.

list.name: The Bench
list.blurb: Restorations, prints, builds and half-finished projects.
list.intro: Things made and things brought back.
list.empty: Restorations, prints, builds and half-finished projects.

list.name: Stage Distractions
list.blurb: Rating lab equipment in film and television. Right instrument? Used correctly? Could they possibly be seeing that?
list.intro: Rating lab equipment in film and television.
list.empty: Every entry gets scored on the same three axes: is it the right instrument for the setting, is anyone using it correctly, and could they plausibly be seeing what the script says they are seeing.

list.name: Telescopy
list.blurb: The same instrument, pointed the other way.
list.intro: The same instrument, pointed the other way.
list.empty: Mounts, seeing, collimation, and the nights that turned out to be worth staying up for.
